# cDot (www.cdot.world)

cDot is purpose built infrastructure for the next era of money movement and identity at scale,
where verified identity, stablecoin payments, programmable money and autonomous accountable
agents converge. Rather than forcing everything onto a single chain, cDot is a set of purpose
built blockchains, each engineered for what it does best, interoperating as one trusted network.

Mission: provide the settlement layer for value exchanged between people, businesses, and machines.

The problem: stablecoins enable instant, borderless, programmable transactions, but existing
blockchain infrastructure is either fully general or optimized for trading, and none treat
identity as a first-class primitive. Managing identity by only proving you are a human reaches
its limit for payments and regulation. cDot introduces privacy with accountability: cryptographic
avatars of the user's real identity. Payments at scale need to know, verifiably, who or what is
on each side of a transaction - critical as AI agents transact on behalf of humans and businesses.

The network (three chains, interoperable by design):
1. Identity and asset recovery chain - for people, businesses, and AI agents; privacy with
   accountability via cryptographic avatars of verified real identities. 15,000 tx/s through a
   highly parallel architecture, WASM smart contracts, 20 s finality, permissionless, public and
   pseudonymous, designed to run over thousands of low hardware, unreliable nodes around the
   world for maximum resilience and decentralization.
2. Stablecoin and agentic payment chain - high-throughput, low-cost global settlement and
   programmable money with native on and off ramping; 30,000 tx/s, finality under 1 s, byzantine security 45%; autonomous
   agents transact within verifiable, revocable permissions granted by their principals.
3. Trading chain - a high performance decentralized exchange. 30,000 tx/s through native
   multithreaded operations, finality under 1 s, a high performance permissioned overlay of
   ~50 nodes on top of the C-Layer, private and accountable, native NASDAQ-like matching engine.

Use cases: global payments and payroll, remittances, embedded finance, microtransactions,
machine-to-machine commerce, on and off ramping, asset recovery (never lose your
self custodied crypto), bank accounts - every transaction settles instantly, every participant (human or
agent) is certified and accountable, while real identities and transactions stay private.

Live network map data: https://map.c-layer.certonym.org/api/data
